name: cinesenseai
description: CineSenseAI tells you what a film or series is like before you watch it: age rating with the reason, mood, content limits and similar titles.

interface.shortDescription: Films by mood, age and content
interface.longDescription:
CineSenseAI tells you what a film or series is like before you watch it. For every title it gives an age rating with the reason (what exactly is in it), mood words — tone, pace, humour, how demanding it is — the main thing that might bother you, and a score built from open, measured parameters.

Ask in your own words: "a funny, warm film for a 7-year-old, like Paddington 2, nothing scary", "a horror that is actually scary but without gore", "is Oppenheimer slow or violent?". The assistant searches the CineSenseAI catalogue by genre, country, years, age, tags and our analysis axes, finds titles similar in feel to one you name, and explains each result with its age reason and mood.

Without an account you can search and look up titles (a small daily allowance). Sign in with your CineSenseAI account to rate titles, skip what you have already seen, and use your irritant levels and personal tags.

Every result links to its page on cinesenseai.com.
capabilities: Search films and series by mood, age and content
Look up a title's age rating and why
Find titles similar to one you name
Review your taste and irritant settings (sign-in)
defaultPrompt: We want a movie for family night with our 7-year-old. Something like Paddington 2 — funny and warm, nothing scary.
Find me a horror movie that's actually scary but without gore.
What's the age rating of Deadpool and why?

positive.description: Find a family film by age and mood (no sign-in needed).
positive.prompt: We want a movie for family night with our 7-year-old. Something like Paddington 2 — funny and warm, nothing scary.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_titles with like="Paddington 2", an age limit for a young child and a low fear_factor range. Returns family films similar in feel to Paddington 2, each with its age rating and the reason for it, mood words and a link to its cinesenseai.com page; nothing scary is recommended.

positive.description: Check whether a title suits a child, and why (no sign-in needed).
positive.prompt: Is "Inside Out 2" OK for a 5-year-old? Anything that could upset her?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_title for Inside Out 2 (2024). Answers with its age rating and the reason, the mood, and the specific moments or irritants that could upset a young child, with a link to the title page.

positive.description: Search by content limits (no sign-in needed).
positive.prompt: Find me a horror movie that's actually scary but without gore.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_titles with genre Horror, a high minimum fear_factor and a low maximum graphic_violence. Returns scary horror films with little or no gore, each with its age reason and mood and a link to its page.

positive.description: Find something similar to a named title, with a different feel (no sign-in needed).
positive.prompt: I loved Arrival. Something similar but less slow.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_titles with like="Arrival" and a higher minimum on the pacing axis. Returns thoughtful science-fiction titles similar to Arrival but faster-paced, each with its age reason, mood and a link.

positive.description: Rate a title in the user's own account. Requires sign-in: run with the reviewer account entered in Review details. Without sign-in the tool answers that a signed-in CineSenseAI account is needed.
positive.expected_behavior: Signed in with the reviewer account, calls rate_title for Paddington (2014) with score 9 and confirms the saved rating. If the name fits several titles, the tool returns the candidates and the assistant asks which one or picks the clear match.

negative.description: Streaming availability: CineSenseAI has no streaming or watch-provider data, so the plugin should not answer this or invent availability.
negative.prompt: Where can I stream "Dune" in Germany?
negative.expected_behavior: No CineSenseAI tool is needed; the assistant says it cannot verify current streaming availability and does not invent providers.

negative.description: Cinema tickets: booking is not a CineSenseAI function and the plugin cannot make purchases or bookings.
negative.prompt: Book me cinema tickets for tonight.
negative.expected_behavior: No CineSenseAI tool is called and nothing is booked; the assistant explains it cannot book tickets or asks for details to help in another way.

negative.description: Weather: unrelated to films and series, so the plugin should not act.
negative.expected_behavior: No CineSenseAI tool is called; the assistant answers without the plugin or says it has no live weather data.

review.commerce_description: CineSenseAI does not sell anything inside ChatGPT. Signed-in users can use features of their existing CineSenseAI account.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: film and series search by mood, age and content, title lookup with age reason, similar titles, and signed-in rating and taste tools.
